current_evidence: The council's 'Pre-planning and planning application forms' page links this document ('Planning Services Local List of Information Requirements, Revision 4') as the local list. No newer version is linked. The undated 'for consultation' PDF also on the site looks older (Forms A-F, DMPO 2010/2015 edits). Revision 4 carries no adoption date; it says only that the list was 'adopted in 2011 and was last reviewed in 2018' and cites 2021 documents.

issues.detail: The List date 2022-02-01 comes from PDF metadata. The document text gives no date for Revision 4. It says the list was adopted in 2011 and last reviewed in 2018, and it cites the Fire Statement regime (1 August 2021) and the Net Zero Strategy (October 2021), so it was revised around 2021-22. The workbook should mark the date as approximate or undated in the text. Its 'Outdated (>2y)? Yes' flag is reasonable.
issues.evidence: 'The original Local List was adopted in 2011 and was last reviewed in 2018.'

issues.detail: Outline, Reserved matters, Variation of condition s73, Minerals & waste (county) and County own devt (Reg 3) all say 'No specific local requirements identified'. This County list exists specifically for minerals, waste and County Council (Reg 3) development. It has Validation Checklist Form A (outline/full), Form B (s73/73A) and Form C (reserved matters), and LR35 requires a completed checklist for all applications. The minerals/waste and Reg 3 rows should carry the whole LR1-LR35 list.
issues.evidence: LR1: 'All full applications for minerals, waste and County Council development'; 'VALIDATION CHECKLIST FORM C APPLICATIONS FOR THE APPROVAL OF RESERVED MATTERS'

issues.detail: About 25 requirements are tagged 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning' (e.g. Air Quality, Arboricultural, Drainage, Ecology, FRA, Lighting, Transport, Travel Plan, Planning Obligations). The source applies them to outline and full minerals, waste and County Council applications (Form A), so they belong under Outline and the county-specific types too. Separately, the Householder and Listed building consent rows are not relevant to a county planning authority, which does not determine householder or LBC applications. The LBC rows ('Advertisement drawings / illumination details', 'Heritage Statement') are misplaced; the first is LR23 Lighting Assessment text.
issues.evidence: LR23 Lighting Assessment: 'Proposals including external lighting'

issues.detail: Many county local requirements were not captured. LR2 Planning/Supporting Statement (most applications without an ES). LR7.3 Geological Interest Assessment. LR10 Green and Blue Infrastructure. LR11 Hydrology/Hydrogeology Statement (ground disturbance affecting water, or polluting processes). LR12 Contaminated Land Assessment. LR16 Public Rights of Way (diversion, extinguishment, closure). LR18 Dust Assessment. LR20 Odour Assessment (waste, composting, AD, MBT, remediation). LR21 Bioaerosol Assessment (composting and AD). LR24 Waste Management Statement (ground excavations). LR26 Community Use Statement (mainly schools). LR28 Ground Stability / Mining Risk Assessment (Coal Authority High Risk Development Area). LR29 Soil Assessment (significant loss of agricultural land). LR30 Economic Statement. LR31 Climate Change / Energy / Sustainability Statement (all minerals and waste development; County Council development proportionate to scale). LR33 Cumulative Impact Assessment.
issues.evidence: Section 3 headings LR1-LR35 of 'Planning Services Local List of Information Requirements Revision 4'

issues.detail: Several triggers are wrong text. 'Health Impact Assessment' has Heritage text ('should describe the significance of any heritage assets affected'); the real LR32 trigger is development with potential to affect human health. 'Fire Statement' omits the trigger of buildings with 2+ dwellings or educational accommodation that are 18m+ or 7+ storeys. 'Travel Plan' cites only the schools case and omits 'applications with a TA/TS'. 'Ecological Survey' reads 'case. 3.64 Ecological surveys should ordinarily be no more than two years old.' 'Sequential / Exception Test' quotes only when it is NOT required. 'Odour / Dust / Vibration' quotes the acoustician qualification.
issues.evidence: LR32.1: 'must include a Fire Statement' for buildings 18 metres or more / seven or more storeys

issues.detail: Several rows are not requirements. 'Ventilation / Extraction details (odour)' is not a heading in the County list; its excerpt is Air Quality text ('dust, odour, traffic pollution, bio-aerosols'). 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' ('agreed at pre-application discussions.') and 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' are fragments of the block plan guidance. The 'Block plan' trigger quotes only the exception. Tab items under 'Submission rules' include document-management boilerplate about PDF 'link rot' and website addresses.
issues.evidence: Tab item: 'Updates or changes to the naming of a PDF document changes its URL ... resulting in link rot'

issues.detail: Three near-identical 'Submission rules' tab items repeat the invalid-application warning ('Failure to provide all the National List Requirements and the relevant Local List Requirements will result in the application being invalid'). One of them ends with a form field label ('Location of Proposed Development:').
The 'Planning page' field is only the council home page. The page that actually links the list is the 'Pre-planning and planning application forms' index.

summary: Grokbot's link is still the County's current local list (Revision 4, undated in its text, last formally reviewed in 2018). However, it missed about 16 of the 35 LR items, used misattributed triggers (e.g. HIA quoting heritage text) and wrongly says outline, reserved matters, s73, minerals/waste and Reg 3 have no local requirements, although this list exists for exactly those applications.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
